speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The feast. Nick has the girl. Stop at her entrance, and do not speak her on.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have the side. I will not say her first word.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What does she know of the boy when she comes on?

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Of the man her mother has chosen?

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: A name and a face across a hall.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then she's not shy, master. She's only careful.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again. I am writing it down.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: She's not shy. She's only careful.

speaker: will_kemp
text: If the girl is done being wise, give me the man with the napkin and the joint-stool.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He cannot get the room cleared before the dancing. That is the whole of him. Play it straight.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Straight is a long job for a napkin. I'll do it. I will not ask you for a song.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The boy at the feast talks like a man who has read too many sonnets.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I have the old man. I like him better than the young one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then keep him so, Thomas. The lover can wait on his book.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: An old man with a full house, and a daughter he means to settle, is a part a man can stand in. The young one is all promise.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And she is careful of both. I can play careful without a speech of hers.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Still no copy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Still no copy. I shall go home with fewer illusions about it, and a clearer reason to finish it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Finish it in the country. The heat will keep till thou art back.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Leave the napkin as it played. Do not put a jig inside the man's work.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will keep the old man as I like him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep him. I have the boy's sentence. That is the morning's use.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then I put the ink away, and the paper with it.
